issue.title: Split the REFERENCES badge tooltip into awake and snoozed counts

task_type_fields.proposal: Show awake versus snoozed reference counts in the dash REFERENCES badge tooltip using bob ref list JSON or the shared Reading Board data seam. Keep the displayed Base-view count contract unless the owner explicitly approves changing it. Existing docs/dashboard.md and dashboardCollections still count refs.base Reading Queue, while readingBoardModel already computes awake/snoozed. Proposed by bob-cli-99.4 note 2; reuse the authoritative read-only data path and add focused tooltip/cache tests.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: plan:202610/reading_board.md explicitly preserves REFERENCES badge semantics and refs.base; changing the tooltip is a separately proposed product enhancement.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-99.4 note 2 proposes a tooltip that can explain blocked references after the Reading Board exposes authoritative lane counts.
